name: Rubescent-Cwm
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a nearby asteroid belt, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Nothing about the temporal distortion zone appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever controls carbon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
